name: Retrieval for Mauren
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Travelers keep asking me about the Stonetalon Mountains. It seems to be a popular place for adventure--it doesn't matter if you're seeking wyvern, elementals, or you have business with the Venture Co.

Within the Charred Vale, deep in Stonetalon, there used to be a species of basilisks whose scales, when ground to dust, made a wonderful reagent for some spells I've created.

If those basilisks still live, I would love to have a few of their scales.

Take your time, it is no rush, but I can pay well.
narrative.objectives: Bring 8 Crystalized Scales to Collin Mauren in Stormwind.
narrative.offerRewardText:
This is perfect, adventurer. Thank you greatly.

Perhaps one day in the future I'll be able to help you as you have helped me.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Hello again, adventurer.

Have you already returned from the Vale in Stonetalon with those scales?
